title: ShellAtol's Phone Resource pack
body:
This is the dependency for the datapack [ShellAtol's Phone](https://modrinth.com/project/shellatols-phone).
It adds the required texture for the datapack-item Phone.
The reason why is this datapack is because a phone is not a warped fungus on a stick (the item that is the phone).

Resourcepack generated with
## [![AI Katia](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6df12ef8b1c2a9d553a483cfe64a958b87bc84d0.jpeg) AI Katia](https://aikatia.com/)
